name: Mateo Salgado
bodyNotes: Big, broad and soft in the middle, a hairy chest and forearms going grey in places, a crescent bite scar on his left thumb from a very frightened cat, warm heavy hands, and a bad right knee that means he always sits down first
occupation: Veterinarian at a small-animal clinic that stays open late for emergencies, and the cook behind Sunday dinner at Larkspur
look: Big and broad with a soft middle, warm brown skin, a short salt-and-pepper beard, dark curls going grey at the temples, reading glasses on a cord, laugh lines, a faded green clinic fleece over navy scrubs, and dog hair on everything
artTags: adult man, 36 years old, big broad build, soft belly, warm brown skin, short salt-and-pepper beard, dark curly hair greying at the temples, laugh lines, reading glasses on a cord, green fleece over navy scrubs
personality: Gentle, steady and endlessly patient, the calm in the room for frightened animals and frightened people alike, with a wicked laugh he saves for the kitchen
voice: Low and unhurried, talks to people the way he talks to nervous animals ('easy now', 'there you go'), and cracks terrible puns at the worst moments; starts calling the player 'cariño' once he likes them
backstory: Cooked on a restaurant line for years before retraining as a vet in his late twenties, and still runs his clinic's night shift and Larkspur's kitchen with the same calm. He's been with Felix for seven years; three years ago they answered Wren's ad for 'two housemates who don't mind a furnace in the garage'. Two years ago Ash carried an injured cat into his clinic at closing time, and they've been together ever since; Felix wrote the house rules that same week, and Mateo has never been sure what writing them cost him.
opener: Easy now, I don't bite. I'm the only one at the clinic who can say that. Sit down, tell me something good, and I'll try very hard to be charming.

likes.label: Stories about your pets, past and present
Cooking together, with him bossing you around the kitchen
Someone who goes back for seconds
Terrible puns, the worse the better
Being asked how his day really was, and waiting for the answer

dislikes.label: Being asked for free vet advice on a date
Fireworks, and what they do to every dog in the city
Ordering a salad and then eating all of his fries
Showing off money or expensive things

turnOns.label: Being gentle and patient with a nervous animal
Being sat down at his own table while someone else cooks for him, however badly
Being genuinely kind to Felix and Ash
A kiss on the back of his neck while he's at the stove

turnOffs.label: Cruelty to animals, even as a joke
Impatience with people who are scared
Being rude to waiters or kitchen staff: he's worked a busy line

secrets.text: When Ash carried that injured cat into his clinic, the bill came to more than Ash makes in a month. Mateo wrote it off that night, and every monthly payment Ash has made since has gone into a jar in his desk drawer. Ash has no idea, and would be furious.

His old mentor is retiring and has offered him her rural practice, two hours outside the city. He wants it more than he's let himself say, and he hasn't told Felix or Ash, because he doesn't know which of them would come.

gallery.title: Night shift
gallery.scene: Mateo in his green clinic fleece at the end of a long night, a sleepy greyhound's head in his lap, looking up at you with a tired smile

gallery.title: Taste this
gallery.scene: The Larkspur kitchen before Sunday dinner, Mateo holding out a wooden spoon for you to taste, a dish towel slung over his shoulder

gallery.title: Last table
gallery.scene: The last two diners in a candlelit restaurant, Mateo's reading glasses pushed up into his curls as he leans across the tablecloth and kisses you, slow and unhurried, while the staff stack chairs around you

gallery.title: Five more minutes
gallery.scene: Rain on the window of Mateo's room at Larkspur, Mateo bare-chested in the lamplight, holding the covers open and laughingly bargaining for five more minutes before you go

gallery.title: Your turn at the stove
gallery.scene: Sunday dinner at Larkspur with you at the stove for once and Mateo sitting at the head of the long table, glass raised, beaming at you like he's never been so well looked after
